messages:
frank miller: opened a PR to add a "Chargeback & Quota" examples section under Dedicated provisioning. Link: https://git/repo/pulls/5401
anya ivanova: Nice. Can we show 2 concrete examples: per-tenant token quota and pooled tenant quota with shared burst buckets? Ops asks for exact error behavior when quotas are hit.
peter cho: add a Terraform snippet + SDK snippet. Also call out which metrics to watch for chargeback (tokens_consumed, quota_utilization, throttle_count).
frank miller: pushing a sample Terraform snippet and a note about the enforcement window. Draft enforcement wording: "When a tenant exceeds a quota, requests will be rate-limited; retries may succeed after quota window resets (<=60s)." Thoughts?
legal-bot: prefer "transient throttling" over "rate-limited" and avoid exact guarantees. Suggested phrasing: "Quota enforcement is subject to transient throttling; duration depends on workload and pool characteristics."
anya ivanova: ops wants a conservative number for doc readers. Can we say "typical retry success < 60s, may vary"? That helps engineers plan backoff.
ops-bot: ops confirms: conservative guidance OK. For pooled burst, note that eviction/preemption can cause additional throttling; recommend scheduling large migrations during off-peak windows.
frank miller: added both phrasings: legal preferred line plus parenthetical "typical retry success <60s". Included a tiny example for per-tenant quota using Terraform and a Python SDK snippet.

```hcl
# Terraform example: per-tenant quota
resource "redwood_dedicated_tenant" "acme" {
  name = "acme"
  quota_tokens_per_minute = 10000
}
```

```python
# Python SDK: adjust tenant quota
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
c.tenants.update('t-acme', quota={'tokens_per_minute': 10000})
```

frank miller: I also added a short chargeback billing note pointing to /handbook/billing/chargeback.md and a quick smoke test checklist (create tenant, hit quota, observe 429/metric).
peter cho: lint: add SDK min versions (python SDK >=0.10.1, CLI >=1.14.2) and cross-link to migration doc. docs-bot: flagged missing link to /handbook/dedicated/migration.md.
docs-bot: formatting ok. Reminder: add changelog entry and tag docs-oncall.
anya ivanova: can someone run the staging smoke? I'll coordinate a small tenant and ramp to 150% of quota to confirm behavior.
ops-bot: queued smoke test: staging -> /handbook/dedicated at 5112223400 by frank miller
frank miller: running smoke now. will post results.
ops-bot: smoke result: when quota exceeded, API returned 429 with body {"error":"quota_exceeded"}, retry after headers present; observed successful retries after ~35s. Metrics: quota_utilization peaked, throttle_count incremented. No 5xxs.
peter cho: perfect. small nit: in autoscale section we should clarify that quota throttling is independent of autoscale triggers; added a one-line clarification in PR comments.
frank miller: merging after one approval and changelog entry. I'll open a follow-up to add a short sample for pooled-burst accounting and a link to chargeback billing. Thanks all :tada:
